notes.title: Alice's World Development Update - August 2025
notes.content: [p]Thank you for your attention! Two months have passed, and summer is coming to a close.[/p][p][i]Alice's World[/i] is now in its final development stage. Here’s a look at what we’ve been working on:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Character Voice Acting[/b] [/h3][p]After a long and painful consideration (mostly due to budget and development time), we've made a big decision—we are adding character voice acting to [i]Alice's World[/i]! You'll soon be able to hear Alice’s voice! We will officially announce more details about the voice cast soon.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002905/c3427e649ebfb0c5d503ae603853e6e6efb233c3.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Multiple Endings[/b] [/h3][p]The game will feature three different endings that change based on your choices. You can be honest, or you can deceive. You can protect her, or you can let her go. No matter what you choose, she will always believe in you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002905/415b73553a44e0dd62d9fbb9283c53317dcc7b23.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]More Illustrations and Visual Optimizations[/b][/h3][p]We've added new dynamic effects and drawn new event illustrations. The tower that can grant wishes, the empty mansion… As the story progresses, the secrets of the world will gradually be revealed.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002905/fb5dcfa30b9ab6eaa9e3ecf9d0548644abdd4307.gif"][/img][/p][h3][b]Attending Busan Indie Connect[/b] [/h3][p]“We want more people to meet Alice!” [/p][p]We participated in the 2025 Busan Indie Connect festival and had the chance to interact with many players from Korea face-to-face. Thank you to everyone who visited and provided feedback. We hope Korean players will love the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002905/09e6cc8efb9a8b879b56a8da551fdec7c966f791.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The game is scheduled for release in 2025. A single playthrough will take approximately 2-4 hours, depending on an individual's puzzle-solving and reading speed. [/p][p]Please continue to support us as we work to complete this game! The game demo is currently available, and we welcome your feedback—it will be a great help to us![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3259820/_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Alice’s World Demo – Now Available Again!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002905/892254d8658903ce22da7afd7ac306df06171f71.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!
Thanks to all your feedback, we've spent the past few months improving the demo, and it's finally back on March 22! Here’s what’s new:

[h2]Major Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🎮 Controller Support – Prefer playing with a gamepad? The game now fully supports controllers and displays proper button prompts.
[*] 📝 Text Improvements – We’ve polished the script, added new story bits, and improved system responses based on different choices.
[*] 💬 Talk Anytime – Many players felt the waiting times were too long, so now you can chat with Alice whenever you want!
[*] 🌍 Localized Cover Images – The game’s cover in your library now matches your selected language for better localization.
[/list]

[h2]Additional Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added more dialogue for equippable items
[*] Adjusted some sound effects
[*] You can now skip the logo intro
[*] Updated some illustrations
[/list]

Thanks for your patience and support! The adjustments took longer than expected, but the full game is still planned for release this year.
If you haven't already, consider adding Alice's World to your wishlist, or leave us review on the demo—it really helps us out! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2439560/Alices_World/

notes.title: Development Update for Alice’s World: A Look at What’s Next
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who has supported Alice’s World! Since releasing the demo, we’ve received so much feedback and encouragement from the community. Today, we’d like to share some updates on the game’s development progress!

[h2] Development Highlights [/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Game Text Refinement[/b]
We’ve polished the in-game text to eliminate logical inconsistencies in player-driven choices.
[*] [b]ALice System Upgrade[/b]
The ALice system module has been enhanced for smoother and more natural communication.
[*] [b]Controller Prompt Display[/b]
The system now displays control prompts that match the specific controller players are using.
[*] [b]More Object Interactions[/b]
Expanded interactions between equipped objects and the environment, unlocking even more surprising outcomes.
[*][b] Voice Acting[/b]
We’ve added voiceovers to bring the game’s characters to life.
[/list]

The full game will feature four chapters and multiple endings. The current demo covers the first chapter, and we’re aiming for a full release in Q2 2025 (fingers crossed!).

If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to join our community on QQ or Discord, or leave us a comment.

notes.title: "Alice's World" Steam Page released, the girl hears "your" voice from in front of the screen
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/bcb8ac1e2aa0c4c98220fb152a0303ecce06e954.png[/img]
Alice's World is a story-driven 2D adventure puzzle game.
The girl opens her eyes in a desolate world, and hears "your" voice from in front of the screen.
You can direct her actions, help her solve mysteries, evade dangers, and find a way to leave this place. Of course, you could also choose not to do so, or even worse, deliberately guide her to death... Just kidding, you surely wouldn't do that, right?
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2439560/Alices_World/
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/b49d52caa40ed999c4231937661499124b6de4ac.jpg[/img]
[h2]【Game Features】[/h2]
[list][*]There is no role-playing! You are yourself, sitting in front of the screen, guiding the in-game character.
[*]Explore the stories hidden behind the desolate world, unravel the truth layer by layer.
[*]Exquisite Japanese-style art and full voice acting bring an immersive experience.[/list]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/9e79f45938240209d61449759220516509a38062.jpg[/img][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/4d1759dee13a21b06e099af803e9f7edc449b451.gif[/img][img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33017256/ecf8e07845fac84ee2d416a0815515e55ad313e2.jpg[/img]
[h1]【Story Rich】[/h1]
